physics_findings.finding: Original Hu eight values remain authoritative
physics_findings.reason: The candidate selects only saved element_regularization_force. It does not reconstruct rounded J/Hu, exp coefficient, DD low words, P, hyperstress or energy. Multiplication by exact signs is used only for a structural comparison with original four vertex vectors.

physics_findings.finding: Q1 sign-pattern gate has the correct tensor factor and node order
physics_findings.reason: Actual rectangular operators have both XY and YX Hessian entries with BL/BR/TR/TL signs +,-,+,-. Hu is element constant. r_Hu=c_e H^T Hu therefore has that alternating vector pattern; no missing factor-one simplification or thickness multiplication is introduced. The numeric array_equal gate deliberately excludes signed-zero/byte equality.

An adjacent selected body-node pair has opposite original Hu vectors and zero resultant for common translation if its numeric pattern gate passes. A single corner_only vertex can retain action. Assembled edge-node vectors can remain through neighbouring owner endpoint differences. This is a discrete vertex action, not a unique continuous face pressure or proof that only macroscopic corners have node loads.

physics_findings.finding: Compact original scatter gate is justified
physics_findings.reason: Support rows cover every cell incident to the closed body, ordered by original ascending cell ID. The API appends selected local/component entries in original C order, accumulates positive internal forces using float64 bincount, then negates. Deleting contributions to other DOFs does not alter the input addition sequence for any retained body DOF. Each compact result can therefore be compared numerically exactly with the original M2 node Hu text parsed back to binary64. The claim is body-only and does not claim full-domain replay.

physics_findings.finding: Original nodal and new local closure boundaries remain distinct
physics_findings.reason: The API retains original node-fsum versus original-state whole with8eps*original-node Hu L1. Newly regrouped local force versus each original node, and local whole versus original-node whole, use8eps*corresponding original selected-local Hu L1. At most four original local terms feed a node; the additive rounding and final fsum rounding are controlled by that absolute sum. Propagating these node accumulation errors to the whole also uses original local L1. No absolute floor, percentage gate or state-force magnitude scaling is introduced.

Five owner roles, corner-only resultants and original whole differences are retained without a new equality gate. Material/total original text is copied, never recomputed as Hu plus material. No new total=material+Hu gate, energy gradient, pressure or clamp test exists.

physics_findings.finding: Original energy-gradient prohibition has primary support
physics_findings.reason: P26 supplied PDF page4 Eq6 explicitly places exp(-5detF) in the weak Hu term outside the stated energy density and describes a generally nonsymmetric tangent. The naive .5*c_e*||Hu||^2 derivative contains an additional term omitted by the original force. Page4 Eq5/7 gives Q1 Lu=0; page5 notes alpha-related physical error. This candidate preserves the original residual rather than treating those choices as implementation defects.
